en: What does the word in capitals mean? “The REMOTE village had no shops for miles.”
No shops for miles tells us the village is far from everywhere.
What does the word in capitals mean? “She was FURIOUS when her bike went missing.”
Losing a bike would make someone cross, so furious means very angry.
What does the word in capitals mean? “Please be BRIEF – we only have a minute.”
Having only a minute means the speaker must keep it short.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The ANCIENT castle has stood for 900 years.”
Something that has stood for 900 years is very old.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The puppy was TIMID and hid under the table.”
Hiding under the table shows the puppy was shy and nervous.
What does the word in capitals mean? “We need to CONSERVE water during the dry summer.”
When water is short, we must save it.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The instructions were so VAGUE that nobody understood them.”
Nobody understood them, so the instructions were not clear.
What does the word in capitals mean? “He felt ELATED after winning the prize.”
Winning a prize makes you feel thrilled, so elated means extremely happy.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The path was too NARROW for two bikes side by side.”
Two bikes could not fit side by side, so the path was not wide enough.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The lion crept through the grass towards its PREY.”
Prey is an animal that is hunted by another animal for food.
What does the word in capitals mean? “Mia was RELUCTANT to jump into the cold pool.”
A cold pool would make someone not want to jump, so reluctant means unwilling.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The film was so TEDIOUS that I fell asleep.”
Falling asleep shows the film was dull and boring.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The desert is ARID, with almost no rain all year.”
Almost no rain means the land is very dry.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The BARK on the old oak tree was rough.”
the outer covering of a tree
Here bark is on a tree, so it means the tree’s rough outer layer.
What does the word in capitals mean? “I can’t BEAR to watch the sad ending again.”
In this sentence bear means put up with or stand.
What does the word in capitals mean? “Leave the bread dough to RISE for an hour.”
Bread dough puffs up and gets bigger as it rests.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The sea was CALM after the storm had passed.”
Once the storm has passed, the sea becomes still and quiet.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The ABUNDANT apples covered the whole orchard floor.”
So many apples covered the ground that there were plenty of them.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The glass vase is FRAGILE, so handle it gently.”
Handling it gently suggests it could break easily.
What does the word in capitals mean? “We were told to OBSERVE the snail closely.”
To observe something closely is to watch it carefully.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The new park will BENEFIT everyone in the town.”
A new park is good for people, so benefit means help.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The magician made the coin VANISH.”
A magician’s trick makes the coin seem to disappear.
What does the word in capitals mean? “She gave a SINCERE apology and promised to do better.”
Promising to do better shows she really meant it.
What does the word in capitals mean? “We tried to PERSUADE Dad to let us have a puppy.”
To persuade someone is to get them to agree with you.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The climbers reached the SUMMIT at noon and enjoyed the view.”
Climbers aim to reach the top, where they can enjoy the view.
What does the word in capitals mean? “Bats are NOCTURNAL, so they hunt for food at night.”
The sentence tells us they hunt at night, so nocturnal means active at night.
What does the word in capitals mean? “Our hockey MATCH against the other school starts at three.”
a small stick for lighting a fire
In this sentence match means a game between two teams.
What does the word in capitals mean? “Ben is very GENEROUS – he always shares his sweets.”
Always sharing shows Ben likes to give to others.
What does the word in capitals mean? “The old wooden bridge might COLLAPSE if too many people cross it.”
Too much weight could make the bridge fall down.
What does the word in capitals mean? “Each SCALE on the snake’s skin was smooth and shiny.”
a small plate covering the skin
Here scale is on a snake’s skin, so it means one of the small plates that cover it.

example.q_en: What does the word in capitals mean? “The REMOTE village had no shops for miles.”
example.why_en: No shops for miles tells us the village is far from everywhere.

en.title: Words in context
en.teach: Clues in the rest of the sentence help you work out what a word means. In “The desert is arid, with almost no rain”, the clue “no rain” tells you arid means very dry.
